# TruIdentity Screening Solutions

TruIdentity Screening Solutions is a professional fingerprinting and background check service located in McAllen, Texas, serving individuals and organizations throughout the Rio Grande Valley and South Texas.

## Services

- FBI Background Checks ($90) — Official FBI Identity History Summary, results in as little as 24 hours
- FBI Apostille ($220) — FBI background check authenticated for international use (work visas, immigration, residency)
- Ink Fingerprinting ($49) — Traditional ink-rolled FD-258 fingerprint cards, completed same day
- Live Scan Fingerprinting ($49) — Digital fingerprint capture transmitted directly to the FBI, no ink
- NFA Fingerprinting ($49) — Two FD-258 cards for ATF Form 4 / Form 1 NFA transfers
- ATF eFile Services ($75) — Electronic NFA application through ATF eForms, weeks faster than paper
- Mobile Fingerprinting ($49/person) — Professional fingerprinting at your office, school, or facility
- Criminal Background Check — Contact (956) 670-6144 for current pricing
- Pre-Employment Screening — Contact (956) 670-6144 for current pricing
- Tenant Screening — Contact (956) 670-6144 for current pricing

## Service Area

Based in McAllen, TX. Serves Hidalgo, Cameron, and Starr counties and throughout South Texas. Mobile fingerprinting available anywhere in the Rio Grande Valley.

## About

TruIdentity Screening Solutions was founded in 2024 by Bill Hawkins, a former Texas law enforcement officer with extensive investigative experience. The business provides fast, accurate fingerprinting and background screening to individuals and organizations throughout South Texas. Fully bilingual in English and Spanish. Most FBI background check results arrive within 24 hours of submission. The business offers a no-rejection guarantee: if the FBI rejects fingerprints for quality reasons, reprints are provided at no additional charge. Rated 5.0 with 58 five-star Google reviews.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How fast do FBI background check results arrive?
A: Most FBI Identity History Summary results arrive within 24 hours of submission.

Q: Do you accept walk-ins?
A: No — appointment only. Same-day slots are often available Monday–Friday.

Q: What is Live Scan fingerprinting?
A: Live Scan captures fingerprints electronically and transmits them directly to the FBI — no ink, no physical card. Required for teachers, childcare workers, healthcare professionals, and others. Note: Identigo holds an exclusive TX DPS contract — TruIdentity submits Live Scan directly to the FBI.

Q: What is an ORI number?
A: An ORI (Originating Agency Identifier) routes your Live Scan results to the correct agency. Your employer or licensing board provides this number — we cannot supply it.

Q: What do I need for NFA fingerprinting?
A: A valid photo ID, a copy of your ATF Form 4 or Form 1, and NFA trust documents if applicable. We provide two completed FD-258 cards as required by the ATF.

Q: Do you offer mobile fingerprinting?
A: Yes — we bring professional fingerprinting equipment to your location anywhere in South Texas. Ideal for employers, schools, healthcare facilities, and nonprofits. Travel fee may apply.

Q: What forms of payment do you accept?
A: Cash, major credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), Venmo, and Zelle.
